parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Ulakwo (Etche LGA survey stations). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 14.369 | 0.124 | 0.12415
2 | 15.965 | 8.25 | 9.665
3 | 4591.4 | 27.074 | 47.738
4 | 5101.5 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Ulakwo
Curve type: A-type (ρ1 < ρ2 < ρ3 < ρ4)
Aquifer depth: 9.67 m – 47.74 m (with likely continuation into the underlying high-resistivity layer below 47.74 m)
Recommendation: Case and seal the upper weathered/clayey overburden (0–9.67 m) to prevent caving and contamination, then screen the borehole within the thick, highly resistive sand/sandstone unit between approximately 9.7 m and 48 m, which represents the main water-bearing zone; drilling can proceed deeper into the underlying resistive layer if higher yield is required, confirming lithology with drill cuttings as the resistivity contrast alone does not fix the exact aquifer base.
